name: Tono
soft_passes: #2 grid: portrait-crop framing, optically balanced by the black body mass, but not a safe-zone-centered glyph (head/beak right-of-centre)
#4 16px: head #000 and body #3B3B3F merge on downscale to a red-and-black blob; saved by the red breast, yellow bill, and white eye dot
#6 palette: four colour zones (ivory/black/red/yellow-orange) — at the 2-family ceiling; passes because red-to-orange is one warm ramp and the bill is a small focal accent
failures: #10 variant robustness: pre-masked Big Sur raster with a baked ivory ground, no Icon Composer light/dark/clear/tinted layers; near-black bird collapses to a blob and depends on the baked cream field for figure-ground in a tinted/mono render
light_model: Single top-down/upper light. Breast ramps lighter-warmer at top (#F52512) to deeper red at base (#EA0C01); matte-black plumage carries a cool-grey sheen band (#232528->#3B3B3F) for volume; beak top-lit; one specular catchlight in the eye. Soft short baked self-shadow, no long cast. No glass rim-light or refraction.
devices: robin bust portrait cropped to the lower/right mask edges (creature as identity, not a function glyph)
sculpted matte plumage — cool-grey sheen ramp gives volume under top light with no gloss
catchlit white eye-ring as the lone specular and the small-size identification anchor
flat warm-ivory ground instead of a gradient ramp
two-tone bill (yellow upper -> deeper orange lower)
rhymes_hint: warm-ground flat-illustration animal-mascot family (Big Sur era): a creature portrait on a flat cream/ivory field with sculpted matte shading and one saturated focal hue; indie wildlife/character icons that lead with brand personality over a tool glyph
notes: Source 512x512 (half the 1024 master), likely a resized web render from macapp.supply — palette hexes reliable, sub-pixel edge/shadow detail not. RGBA pre-masked squircle (transparent corners, mask inset ~48px@512), Big Sur baked-mask delivery not full-bleed Icon Composer layers (root of #10). Brand coherence icon<->app: weak on palette (cover UI is cool sage-green Liquid-Glass chrome over green nature photos; icon is warm cream/red/black), strong on theme (cover shows rowan/mountain-ash berries, a classic robin food; bird = nature-wallpapers). Subject communication: icon signals identity (warm nature mascot) over function — a viewer cannot infer 'wallpaper manager' from it. First member of a potential illustrated-creature-on-warm-ground cluster.
